page.content:
2003 ocean chase of a clownfish father and a forgetful tang.

How Finding Nemo connects

  • Creator: Andrew Stanton — Andrew Stanton directed Finding Nemo.
  • Character: Marlin — Finding Nemo is Marlin's ocean search.
  • Topic: Pixar — Finding Nemo is a Pixar feature.
  • Character: Nemo — Finding Nemo is the film named for the taken clownfish.
  • Character: Dory — Dory partners Marlin through Finding Nemo.
  • Faction: Clownfish family — The clownfish family is the household Finding Nemo starts from.

What is Finding Nemo?

Finding Nemo follows Marlin across the reef and the East Australian Current to find his son, with Dory as the memory-lost partner who makes the hunt possible.

Key threads lead to Andrew Stanton, Marlin, Pixar, Nemo, Dory and Clownfish family.
